meaning: A barrier that checks the data going into and out of a computer or network. It blocks anything that breaks its safety rules.
clues: It is a tool that helps keep a device or network safe.
It does its job quietly in the background, without you doing anything.
It checks data coming in and going out, and blocks what breaks its rules.
Its name comes from a wall built to stop a real fire from spreading.
It has eight letters and starts with F. Think of a wall that stops a fire.
assumes: Antivirus software scans for harmful programs
A backup is a spare copy of your files

decoys.meaning: Software that scans a device for harmful programs and removes them.
A way to open a phone by looking at it. The phone checks that your face matches the one it saved.
A spare copy of your files, kept in a second place in case the first copy is lost.

exchange.speaker: floyd
exchange.text: Back in my day, our only firewall was the lock on the computer room door.

exchange.speaker: bud
exchange.text: Windows and Mac computers both come with one built in. Take a peek in your settings to check that yours is turned on.
